title: How to Find the Best ATS Resume Keywords
description:
When it comes to optimizing your resume for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and impressing hiring managers, the right keywords are your golden ticket.

In today's video, we're talking all things resume keywords. With Teal, you'll learn:
- Practical strategies to discover and select the most effective resume keywords.
- Examples of how to incorporate these keywords into your resume for maximum impact.
- Tips for tailoring keywords to different job roles and industries.
- Common mistakes to avoid when identifying resume ATS keywords.


Ready to get started? Check out Teal's Resume Builder to craft ATS-optimized resumes.
